title: CytoLex — test corpus of ISCN strings
description: One corpus file per notation type: curated/corpus/<type>.yaml (T-062). Realistic strings that complement the KB examples: combined strings, volume, robustness inputs. Strings are synthetic or adapted from the book: never real patient strings (data policy T-048), so there is no 'lab' source. Format and label policy: curated/corpus/README.md.

id.description: Stable, unique across all corpus files; the prefix names the file (K karyotype, A arr, I ish, N nuc_ish, C combined, R robustness).
id.x-expected: an ID like K-001 (file prefix K/A/I/N/C/R, dash, three digits)

iscn.description: The string as written (book forms →, –, × or typed ASCII forms).

types.description: The notation types of its segments, in order (as the Segmenter splits them).

features.description: What the string exercises (free lower-kebab tags, e.g. translocation, clone-count, mosaic).

rules.description: KB rule IDs the string relies on (its constructs and conventions).

cite.description: The book example the string is adapted from.

expected.description: Expected result per ISCN edition (editions are not backward compatible).

review.description: checked = a person confirmed the expected results.

verdict.description: valid / invalid in this edition, or unreviewed (parse-only: it must split and parse, no claim about validity).

context.description: Context hint the verdict is given for; omitted = no hint.

fires.description: Rule IDs (or core codes such as CORE.UNPARSED) that must be reported; others may be reported too.
